title: I.
author: ryley-o.eth
facts: data contracts: gzip-compressed parts in 24 locked contracts, 422,292 bytes total
one 64×64 RGB eye image per token, drawn in the browser
description: I. draws 64×64 pictures of eyes with human expressions. A small image generator, a type of neural network called a cVAE-GAN, makes each picture. Ethereum stores the full program in 24 data contracts that nobody can change. The program includes the code that runs the model and the compressed weights. On the project site, your browser reads the program from Ethereum and runs it. Apart from Ethereum, it needs no server and no outside code library.

call.note: projectScriptByIndex(0, part) reads one part of the onchain program. Parts 5–18 contain the compressed model weights.
